title: OpenField Studio: connect a box and render, recorded live
_comment: The demo's live beats, recorded against a real GPU box reached through the Connect sheet (never the FAKE stack): start the app on Replay (openfield serve --port 8890 --backend replay) with the tunnel up (9189 = comfy-api-proxy, 9188 = ComfyUI), then python scripts/record_demo.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8890/ --scenario scripts/ui/live4.scenario.json --out <dir>. The readiness check can take minutes on a cold box, so that wait runs as a labelled time-lapse instead of a hard limit.

steps.text: This part is live. A rented box, connected from the header.
steps.caption: Recorded live: a rented RTX 5090, connected from the app.

steps.expr: for (const id of ['connect-url', 'connect-comfy']) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) { el.value = ''; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } }
